description: Upscale an image (2-4× scale). Endpoint requires base64 image; this tool fetches the URL and uploads it. Returns base64 PNG. Supports x402 wallet auth (no Venice account needed) and API key.

creativity.description: How much detail and texture the upscaler invents, 0 to 0.02. Defaults to 0.01. Higher stays further from the source.

image_url.description: Image to upscale: an http(s) URL or an inline base64 data URL. Include a concrete media type in data URLs, e.g. image/jpeg.

scale.description: Upscale factor, 2 to 4. Defaults to 2. Large inputs are scaled down automatically to stay under the 4096x4096 output cap.

name: venice_image_upscale
title: Venice Image Upscale
